The FloPlast uPVC half round gutter provides an essential rainwater drainage solution for diverse building projects. This durable anthracite grey gutter is ideal for new builds, renovations, and guttering replacements, offering reliable performance against weather conditions. Constructed from robust uPVC, it features a high gloss finish that ensures excellent weathering resistance and colour fastness. The pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system facilitates fast and easy installation for trade professionals. With a 112mm diameter, it delivers good flow capacity, suitable for most installations requiring efficient rainwater dispersal.
